corrections.old: Pharyngeal and tonsillar branches, prevertebral (muscular) branches, inferior tympanic artery (through the tympanic canaliculus), and posterior meningeal branches (via the jugular foramen and hypoglossal canal).
corrections.new: Pharyngeal and tonsillar branches, prevertebral (muscular) branches, inferior tympanic artery (through the tympanic canaliculus), and posterior meningeal branches (via the jugular foramen and condylar canal).
corrections.ref: Netter Plate 20 (p75): condylar canal - emissary vein and meningeal branch of ascending pharyngeal artery; hypoglossal canal - CN XII only; consistency with hypoglossal-canal and occipital-bone cards
corrections.reason: Card routed the meningeal branch through the hypoglossal canal; Netter and the bone cards put it in the condylar canal

corrections.new: Upper and lower lips: orbicularis oris, levator labii superioris and levator anguli oris, zygomaticus major and minor, risorius (superior labial); depressor anguli oris, depressor labii inferioris, mentalis (inferior labial); labial glands and mucosa; nasalis, depressor septi and the anterior nasal septum (superior labial septal branch).
corrections.ref: Netter Table 2.9 (p224): zygomaticus major and minor - superior labial artery of facial artery; consistency with zygomaticus-major / zygomaticus-minor Blood supply
corrections.reason: Both zygomaticus cards name the superior labial artery but the labial-arteries card did not list them

corrections.new: Submandibular gland; palatine tonsil, soft palate muscles and pharyngeal wall (ascending palatine, tonsillar); anterior belly of digastric, mylohyoid, genioglossus/hyoglossus and platysma (submental); stylohyoid; masseter and medial pterygoid; buccinator and the muscles of facial expression of the lips, nose and cheek (labial, lateral nasal, angular); orbicularis oculi (angular, with the superficial temporal artery); anastomoses with the ophthalmic artery at the medial canthus.
